nodes_add.name: G. I. Gurdjieff
nodes_add.note: Armenian-Greek teacher of the Fourth Way. Osho's Poona work departments were modelled on Gurdjieff's 1930s community in France, and his picture of 'man as a machine' resembles Gurdjieff's. Birth/death years not verified in this batch.

nodes_add.name: Human potential movement (Esalen and encounter therapy)
nodes_add.note: Western group therapies (encounter, primal, bodywork) brought to the Poona ashram from 1975 by therapists who became sannyasins; Wilhelm Reich's body therapy is cited as an influence on the active meditations. Time magazine called the ashram the 'Esalen East'.

nodes_add.name: Ma Anand Sheela
nodes_add.note: Rajneesh's secretary 1981-85 and head of Rajneeshpuram. Entered Alford pleas on 22 July 1986 to charges including the 1984 Dalles salmonella poisoning and attempted murder of Rajneesh's physician; concurrent sentences up to 20 years; paroled after 29 months; later lived in Switzerland. Birth year given as 1949 or 1950 in different sources; omitted.

nodes_add.name: Osho International Foundation
nodes_add.era: Zurich; formerly Rajneesh International Foundation / Neo-Sannyas International Foundation
nodes_add.note: Swiss foundation that claims copyright in Osho's words and holds the OSHO trademark; runs the Osho International Meditation Resort, Pune. US OSHO marks cancelled January 2009; EU mark upheld by the General Court 11 October 2017. Bombay HC upheld refusal of Pune plot sale 8 April 2024; Supreme Court appeal outcome unreported as of Oct 2026.

nodes_update.name: Osho (Rajneesh)
nodes_update.note: Chandra Mohan Jain, born Kuchwada 11 Dec 1931; awakening by his account 21 Mar 1953, Jabalpur; philosophy lecturer Jabalpur 1958-66; Dynamic Meditation 1970; first neo-sannyas 26 Sept 1970 (Manali); Poona 1974-81; Rajneeshpuram 1981-85; guilty plea to two immigration counts mid-Nov 1985 (later accounts call it an Alford plea; unconfirmed); returned to Pune Jan 1987; died Pune 19 Jan 1990.

edges_upsert.note: Born into a Digambar Jain family whose parents followed Taran Svami; his 1968 sex lectures began at a Jain youth group's Paryushan series and provoked Jain anger.
Discourses on the Vijnana Bhairava Tantra's 112 methods, published as The Book of Secrets.
Tantric acceptance of desire as a path, from the 1968 talks (From Sex to Superconsciousness) through discourses on Tilopa's Song of Mahamudra (Tantra: The Supreme Understanding).
Many Zen discourse series; from early 1988 his talks dealt almost entirely with Zen. Also Tilopa (Tibetan Mahamudra).
Discourse series on Sufi teaching stories; Sufi dance compared with his active meditations.
Discourses on the Gita (title confirmed only via a Romanian bibliography; English/Hindi titles not checked).
Discourse series on the sayings of Jesus and on the Gospel of Thomas.
Discourses on several Upanishads (Kena, Mandukya, Sarvasar, Kaivalya, Adhyatma, Akshya). Lewis Carter saw his ideas as rooted in Advaita.
Discourses on the poems of Kabir.
Poona work communities modelled on Gurdjieff's 1930s community in France; 'man as a machine'.
Therapy groups run at the Poona ashram from 1975 by Western therapists; central to ashram life and income.
Secretary and head of Rajneeshpuram 1981-85; denounced by Rajneesh as a 'gang of fascists' 16 Sept 1985.
Holds copyright and trademark claims to his name and words after his death; runs the Pune resort.

glossary.def: Meditation. In Hindi, dhyan; Osho's early camps taught what he called Rajneesh Dhyan Yoga.
A string of beads, usually 108, for counting prayers or mantras. Osho's neo-sannyasins wore one with his picture in a locket as the sign of initiation.
Lord, blessed one; a word for God also used by devotees of some saints. Rajneesh's title from 1971 to 1989.
The witness: awareness that watches thoughts, feelings and actions without identifying with them. Central to Osho's meditations.
Sexual union. Used in the Hindi title of the talks published in English as From Sex to Superconsciousness.
Zen term for a sudden glimpse of awakening. Common in Osho's Zen discourses.
Osho's form of initiation (from 1970): a new name, orange or red clothes and a mala, worn by people who stay in the world instead of renouncing it.

osho: Born Chandra Mohan Jain 11 Dec 1931, Kuchwada, Raisen; eldest of 11; cloth merchant father; Digambar Jain, Taran Svami -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajneesh
Born 11 Dec 1931 Kuchwada; BA 1955, MA Saugar, began teaching 1957; pleaded guilty 1985; refused by 21 countries; died 19 Jan 1990 Pune -> https://www.britannica.com/print/article/490155

Hitkarini College 1951, D.N. Jain College BA 1955, MA Sagar 1957 with distinction; Raipur vice-chancellor transfer; lecturer 1958, professor 1960, resigned 1966 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajneesh
Enlightenment 21 March 1953, Bhanvartal garden Jabalpur (his account) -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajneesh
Mentors Nani, Pagal Baba, Magga Baba, Masto; Magga Baba touched his feet; Nani first disciple -> https://www.oshonews.com/2026/03/20/oshos-mentors/
Acharya Rajneesh; Gandhi 'masochist reactionary who worshipped poverty'; socialism would socialise poverty; camps from 1962; Jivan Jagruti Kendra -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajneesh

28 Aug 1968 Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan talk at Jain Paryushan series; Gowalia Tank 28 Sept-2 Oct 1968; 25,000-30,000 attended; book From Sex to Superconsciousness -> https://www.oshonews.com/2018/01/07/sex-religion-and-life/
'sex guru' label; Mumbai end June 1970; Woodlands Dec 1970; title Bhagwan 1971 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajneesh
First sannyas 26 Sept 1970 in Kulu Manali -> https://www.oshonews.com/2015/12/26/sannyas-from-the-beginning-to-now/
Manali camp first group of sannyasins; orange lungi and kurta; 'Acharya Rajneesh Ke Pravachan' -> https://www.oshonews.com/2024/09/19/ma-dharm-jyoti-tnn/

Poona 1974 on 21st anniversary; Ma Yoga Mukta (Catherine Venizelos); daily Dynamic, Buddha Hall lectures, evening darshans; therapy groups from 1975; ~30,000 visitors/yr by 1981; violence ended Jan 1979; Price broken arm -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajneesh

Poona day began with Dynamic; 7,000-8,000 people in red; Time 'Esalen East'; Tao Group quote 'two cracked ribs, a concussion, and a subconjunctival hemorrhage in each eye' -> https://newrepublic.com/article/147911/beautiful-place-ashram

Boadella: 'violence, bone-breakinq presented as good for the soul' (OCR); Dick Price resigned after brutality in encounter groups -> https://cdn.ahpweb.org/AHPb/self-and-society/15_05/RSEL_A_11084865_O.pdf
Ashram in Poona film, Wolfgang Dobrowolny, 1981; condemned by followers; woman said therapy helped her overcome fear of men -> https://www.oshonews.com/2011/08/01/ashram-the-movie/
Dynamic Meditation five stages, durations, silent version; source Meditation: The First and Last Freedom -> https://www.oshonews.com/2011/02/15/osho-dynamic-meditation/
Quote 'This is a meditation in which you have to be continuously alert, conscious, aware of whatsoever you do.' (A Bird on the Wing ch.1) -> https://www.oshonews.com/?p=58795
Osho never tells people to begin by just sitting; cathartic methods for modern people -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dynamic_meditation
Kundalini Meditation four 15-minute stages -> https://www.oshonews.com/2011/02/15/osho-kundalini-meditation-2/

Quote 'The new man I talk about, and the new humanity, will not be Eastern or Western. It will believe in the totality of man.' (Book of Wisdom ch.26) -> https://www.oshonews.com/2013/05/27/zorba-the-buddha/
'materialist spiritualist', 'rich man's guru' (Urban) -> https://readingreligion.org/books/zorba-buddha

Gurdjieff work-community model, 'man as machine'; Reich influence on dynamic meditations; Zen exclusively from early 1988; >100 techniques; mala with locket; optional since 1985; denied being religious teacher 30 Sept 1985; 'a religionless religion'; Carter: rooted in Advaita; dictated books in Oregon -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajneesh

Discourse titles on Tilopa, Patanjali, Kabir, Lao Tzu, Chuang Tzu, Upanishads, Jesus, Gospel of Thomas, Sufi stories, Gita, Zen -> https://www.bibmet.ro/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/OSHO_Bibliografie-completa_Simona-Galatchi.pdf
Silence 10 Apr 1981-30 Oct 1984; US 1 June 1981 tourist visa; ranch 64,229 acres $5.75m; moved 29 Aug 1981; incorporated May 1982; 93 Rolls-Royces -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajneesh
Rajneeshpuram coordinates 44.842 N 120.482 W; ~7,000 peak; now Young Life Washington Family Ranch -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajneeshpuram
Sheela and leaders left Sept 14 1985; 750 sickened; plea bargain and agreement to leave -> https://oregonencyclopedia.org/articles/rajneeshees

Salmonella Typhimurium; 751 ill, 45 hospitalised, none died; Sheela and Puja Alford pleas 22 July 1986; concurrent terms up to 20 and 15 years; paroled after 29 months; Rajneesh never prosecuted for attack; 16 Sept 1985 'gang of fascists'; Knapp quote; 1994 study; FitzGerald quote; Torok JAMA 1997 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1984_Rajneeshee_bioterror_attack

Indicted 23 Oct 1985; arrested 28 Oct Charlotte, Learjets, Bermuda; arraigned 8 Nov before Judge Leavy, 34 counts; Alford plea to two counts (visa intent; sham marriage); 10-yr suspended, 5 yrs probation, $400,000; not return 5 yrs -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajneesh
35 counts; 10-year suspended sentence, five years probation, $400,000 fine; ordered by Judge Edward Leavy to leave; left immediately -> https://newrepublic.com/article/147914/bhagwans-final-year

World tour: Delhi 17 Nov 1985; Crete arrest; Uruguay 19 June 1986; Jamaica; Bombay 30 July 1986; Pune Jan 1987; Osho Rajneesh Feb 1989, Osho Sept 1989; last discourse April 1989; epitaph; commune poisoning claim -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajneesh

Died 19 Jan 1990 heart failure; 'Osho left his body at 5:30 p.m. The doctors say it's heart failure,'; Sheela pleaded guilty to attempted murder etc. -> https://archive.seattletimes.com/archive/19900119/1051537/bhagwan-rajneesh-dies-at-58----former-oregon-guru-had-been-living-in-india

Gokani called ~5pm, asked by Amrito and Jayesh to record heart cause to avoid post-mortem; cremated within the hour; Sadhana: 'Anyone can say anything. What's the proof?' and 'It's completely wrong. I cannot comment on it as the matter is in court.' -> https://thequint.com/news/india/was-osho-killed-7-haunting-questions-return-after-26-years

Gokani ENT surgeon (Swami Anand Krishna); Vaidya, Who Killed Osho?; will produced 2013, withdrawn by Jayesh and Amrito -> https://www.thenewsminute.com/article/who-killed-osho-interview-author-abhay-vaidya-64965

2013 FIR by Yogesh Thakkar alleging forged will and misappropriation; Pune police C summary; Bombay HC Oct 2018 refused CBI probe -> https://www.oshonews.com/2018/10/16/bombay-hc-no-to-cbi-probe-into-osho-will/
EU General Court 11 Oct 2017 upheld OIF's OSHO trademark against Osho Lotus Commune, Cologne -> https://www.oshonews.com/2017/10/15/osho-brand-belongs-to-zurich-entity-rules-european-court/

US cancellation Jan 2009 after Osho Friends International challenge; 'The primary significance of Osho is as a religious or meditation movement.'; OIF claims copyright to 'all the published and unpublished words' -> https://www.oshonews.com/2017/12/07/osho-can-the-name-of-an-india-born-spiritual-guru-become-a-european-trademark/
US OSHO trademark lost Jan 2009 after 10-year battle with OFI; ~200,000 visitors/yr (SFGate 2004); two 1.5-acre plots; ten disciples objected -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajneesh_movement

Delhi HC plea by Osho Friends International, March 2025, responses sought from Centre and Trademark Registry -> https://www.barandbench.com/news/litigation/plea-delhi-high-court-disallow-registration-trademarks-name-osho

Land sale: Rs 107 crore to Rajivnayan Rahulkumar Bajaj and Rishab Family Trust, MOU 8 Dec 2020; JCC refused Dec 2023, special audit 2005-2023, funds diverted finding; HC (Kulkarni, Pooniwalla) dismissed 8 Apr 2024, no 'genuine and compelling case'; OIF cited COVID, Ukraine war -> https://www.oshonews.com/2024/04/09/bombay-hc-dismisses-osho-intl-foundations-challenge-to-jcc-denying-it-permission-to-sell-koregaon-plot/
OIF appealed to Supreme Court, listed 22 July 2024 -> https://theprint.in/ground-reports/osho-land-feud-is-a-battle-for-legacy-rebel-swamis-court-cases-bollywood-factor/2183039/
KGW 1984 Peabody documentary -> https://kgw.com/article/news/archive-kgw-documentary-of-rajneeshpuram-commune-in-oregon/283-151859
